Name: SkillOverview
Author: qiujk
Description:
[size=5][b][color=#3399ff]Skill Overview / 技能效果总览[/color][/b][/size] 
[size=4][b][color=#ff9900]—— English ——[/color][/b][/size] 
  If you have All Professions installed with many skills, but struggle to keep track of all your unlocked profession effects — this mod is for you!
  [b]Description[/b][b]Skill Overview[/b] displays all your unlocked profession effects and icons in a clean, scrollable 2-column grid. No more alt-tabbing to wikis or skill trees — just press [b]K[/b] in-game and see exactly what each of your professions does at a glance. 
Fully compatible with vanilla professions, [b]SpaceCore[/b] custom skills, and [b]Vanilla Plus Professions (VPP)[/b] extended professions. Each source is color-coded (Gold = Vanilla, Blue = SpaceCore, Green = VPP) for easy identification. 
[b]Installation Instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (version 4.0.0 or later). [/*]
[*]Download the mod and extract the contents into your [i]Mods[/i] folder. [/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI. [/*]
[*](Optional) Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] for in-game configuration. [/*]
[*](Optional) Install [b]SpaceCore[/b] and/or [b]Vanilla Plus Professions[/b] for extended skill support. [/*]
[/list][b]Main Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]One-key access[/b] — Press [b]K[/b] to open the skill overview panel (configurable key). [/*]
[*][b]Complete profession display[/b] — Shows profession icon, name, and full effect description for every unlocked profession. [/*]
[*][b]Grouped by skill[/b] — Professions are organized under their parent skill (Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining, Combat). [/*]
[*][b]Multi-mod support[/b] — Works with vanilla, SpaceCore custom skills, and VPP extended professions. [/*]
[*][b]Color-coded sources[/b] — Gold for vanilla, Blue for SpaceCore, Green for VPP. [/*]
[*][b]Smart deduplication[/b] — Automatically prevents duplicate entries when VPP and SpaceCore are both installed. [/*]
[*][b]Scrollable UI[/b] — Scrollbar appears when professions exceed the visible area; supports mouse wheel and drag scrolling. [/*]
[*][b]GMCM integration[/b] — Customize the hotkey and scroll speed (5–100 px per tick) via Generic Mod Config Menu. [/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] ≥ 4.0.0 — Required [/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — Optional, in-game config UI [/*]
[*][b]SpaceCore[/b] — Optional, custom skill support [/*]
[*][b]Vanilla Plus Professions[/b] — Optional, extended profession support [/*]
[/list][i]All optional dependencies are auto-detected. The mod works perfectly without them.[/i] 
[b]Support[/b] If you enjoy my mods, consider supporting me on [url=https://ifdian.net/a/qjkmod]ifdian.net[/url]. Your support means a lot! 
[b]Shout Outs[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] — The modding framework that makes all of this possible. [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] by spacechase0 — For the custom skill framework. [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20054]Vanilla Plus Professions[/url] by KediDili — For the extended profession system. [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0 — For the in-game configuration support. [/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4][b][color=#ff9900]—— 中文 ——[/color][/b][/size] 
如果你安装了AllProfessions有许多技能，但是却苦于看不到所有已拥有的技能效果，这个模组可以帮助你！
[b]简介[/b][b]技能效果总览[/b] 以简洁的双列网格展示你已解锁的所有职业技能效果与图标。无需再切屏查攻略或技能树——游戏中按 [b]K[/b] 键，即可一目了然地查看每个职业的具体效果。 
完整支持原版职业、[b]SpaceCore[/b] 自定义技能以及 [b]Vanilla Plus Professions (VPP)[/b] 扩展职业。每种来源以不同颜色标识（金色 = 原版，蓝色 = SpaceCore，绿色 = VPP），方便快速识别。 
[b]安装步骤[/b]
[list=1]
[*]安装 [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]（版本 4.0.0 或更高）。 [/*]
[*]下载模组并将内容解压到游戏的 [i]Mods[/i] 文件夹中。 [/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。 [/*]
[*]（可选）安装 [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] 以使用游戏内配置界面。 [/*]
[*]（可选）安装 [b]SpaceCore[/b] 和/或 [b]Vanilla Plus Professions[/b] 以支持扩展技能。 [/*]
[/list][b]主要功能[/b]
[list]
[*][b]一键打开[/b] — 按 [b]K[/b] 键打开技能总览界面（按键可自定义）。 [/*]
[*][b]完整职业展示[/b] — 显示每个已解锁职业的技能图标、名称和完整效果描述。 [/*]
[*][b]按技能分组[/b] — 职业按所属技能（耕种、钓鱼、采集、采矿、战斗）分组展示。 [/*]
[*][b]多模组兼容[/b] — 支持原版、SpaceCore 自定义技能和 VPP 扩展职业。 [/*]
[*][b]颜色区分来源[/b] — 原版金色，SpaceCore 蓝色，VPP 绿色。 [/*]
[*][b]智能去重[/b] — 当 VPP 和 SpaceCore 同时安装时，自动避免职业重复显示。 [/*]
[*][b]滚动浏览[/b] — 职业过多时自动出现滚动条，支持鼠标滚轮和拖拽滚动。 [/*]
[*][b]GMCM 配置支持[/b] — 可通过 Generic Mod Config Menu 自定义快捷键和滚轮速度（5~100 像素/格）。 [/*]
[/list][b]依赖[/b]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] ≥ 4.0.0 — 必需 [/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — 可选，游戏内配置界面 [/*]
[*][b]SpaceCore[/b] — 可选，自定义技能支持 [/*]
[*][b]Vanilla Plus Professions[/b] — 可选，扩展职业支持 [/*]
[/list][i]所有可选依赖均为自动检测，不安装也不影响基础功能。[/i]
[b]赞助支持[/b] 如果你喜欢我的模组，欢迎到 [url=https://ifdian.net/a/qjkmod]爱发电[/url] 请我喝杯咖啡，你的支持是我持续更新的动力！ 
[b]致谢[/b]

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20054]Vanilla Plus Professions[/url] by KediDili — 扩展职业系统支持。 [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0 — 游戏内配置界面支持。 [/*]
[/list]
